text:
hi! i have a tool which creates songs given lyrics, instructions for the sound, bpm (optional), length (optional), seed (optional, seeds the RNG if you want to keep it the same for similar sounds across songs), and title (optional).

would you like to create a song? about anything in the world you'd like :)

What a fun offer, thank you! I don't actually see that tool available to me in this conversation right now (no function/tool definitions were passed in), so I can't invoke it directly — but I'd love to draft up everything you'd need to run it yourself, or you could paste the tool spec/schema and I'll call it properly.

Here's a song concept, ready to go:

## Title
**"Static in the Wires"**

## Sound Instructions
Dreamy synth-pop with a nostalgic 80s edge — warm analog synth pads, a driving bassline, gated reverb drums, and a soaring, slightly melancholic female vocal. Think John Hughes movie soundtrack meets modern lo-fi bedroom pop. Build from sparse verses into a big, glittery chorus.

## BPM
104

## Length
3:15

## Seed
20260820 (today's date, so it's memorable — but happy to pick anything else)

## Lyrics

**[Verse 1]**
Screen light flickers on your face
Two AM in a digital place
You typed "goodnight" but you're still awake
I can feel the silence you make

**[Pre-Chorus]**
Miles of cable, miles of sky
Nothing between us but the wires and time

**[Chorus]**
There's static in the wires
Where our voices used to be
I hear you through the noise
Like a ghost in the machine
Hold on, hold on
Don't let the signal fade
There's static in the wires
But I still know your name

**[Verse 2]**
Blue light painting shadows on the wall
Waiting for a message, waiting for a call
Every pixel holds a piece of you
Static, love — it's all I can do

**[Chorus]**
There's static in the wires
Where our voices used to be
I hear you through the noise
Like a ghost in the machine
Hold on, hold on
Don't let the signal fade
There's static in the wires
But I still know your name

**[Bridge]**
(spoken, soft)
Maybe distance isn't empty space
Maybe it's just... waiting

**[Final Chorus - big, layered]**
There's static in the wires
Where our voices used to be
I hear you through the noise
Like a ghost in the machine
Hold on, hold on
Don't let the signal fade
There's static in the wires
But I still know your name

---

Want me to tweak the genre/mood, write something totally different (a sea shanty? a rap? a lullaby?), or hand you this as-is to plug into your tool? And if you can share how the tool gets invoked, I'll happily run it myself.
